column1: # Hand labels: what a careful reader says each request explicitly requires. Written by a person,
# never generated from `text::expectations`, so it is an oracle the checker does not share.
# Labels: fast (>= 250 wpm), slow (<= 200 wpm), silent, quiet (rain or quieter), loud (ambient or
# louder), novisuals, or - for nothing explicit. A contradiction ("fast ... slow") requires nothing.
# The no-sound and no-visual phrasings follow the RISE Worker's own tests of explicit words
